library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
R1 <- read_lines(here::here(
  "data", "Week-7-Data", "data", "Battle_Creek_01_chinook_R1.fq.gz")) %>%
  matrix(ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE) %>%
  .[,-3]

colnames(R1) <- c("ID", "seq", "qual")

R1 <- as_tibble(R1)

R1
R1_sep <- R1 %>%
  separate(ID, into = c("id", "part2"), sep = " ") %>%
  separate(
    id,
    into = c("machine", "run", "flow_cell",
             "lane", "tile", "x", "y"),
    sep = ":",
    remove = FALSE,
    convert = TRUE
  ) %>%
  separate(
    part2,
    into = c("read", "filter", "cnum", "barcode"),
    sep = ":",
    convert = TRUE
  )

R1_sep
R1_sep %>%
  count(tile)
utf8ToInt("!+5?IJ") - 33
[1]  0 10 20 30 40 41
R1_sepq <- R1_sep %>%
  mutate(
    mean_qual = map_dbl(
      .x = qual,
      .f = function(x) mean(utf8ToInt(x) - 33)
    )
  )
mean_quality_histogram<- ggplot(R1_sepq, aes(x = mean_qual)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/mean_quality_histogram.pdf",mean_quality_histogram)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/mean_quality_histogram.png",mean_quality_histogram)
x_coordinate_histogram<- ggplot(R1_sepq, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 500)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/x_coordinate_histogram.pdf",x_coordinate_histogram)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/x_coordinate_histogram.png",x_coordinate_histogram)
y_coordinate_histogram<- ggplot(R1_sepq, aes(x = y)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 500) +
  coord_flip()
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/y_coordinate_histogram.pdf",y_coordinate_histogram)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/y_coordinate_histogram.png",y_coordinate_histogram)
spatial_read_distribution<- ggplot(R1_sepq, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 100) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/spatial_read_distribution.pdf",spatial_read_distribution)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/Week-7-Figures/spatial_read_distribution.png",spatial_read_distribution)
spatial_quality_distribution<- ggplot(R1_sepq, aes(x = x, y = y, z = mean_qual)) +
  stat_summary_hex(bins = 100) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c()
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/spatial_quality_distribution.pdf",spatial_quality_distribution)
ggsave("~/Desktop/Fellowship/WLW-ECOS-Conservation-Genomics/Figures/spatial_quality_distribution.png",spatial_quality_distribution)
